sources.label: Circle: native versus bridged Polygon USDC (accessed 2026-09-30)

reserveReview.rationale: Polymarket documents pUSD as an ERC-20 USDC claim with on-chain wrapping and unwrapping. Its concrete CollateralOnramp and CollateralOfframp routes require USDC.e at 0x2791Bca1f2de4661ED88A30C99A7a9449Aa84174 and share an administrative pause gate. Circle identifies that exact token as Ethereum USDC bridged to Polygon, rather than Circle-issued native Polygon USDC. The canonical USDC wrapper link is a reviewed collapsed bridge look-through with the PoS intermediary retained; verified denotes the representation's identity and issuer lineage, not a same-run proof of bridge escrow solvency or unrestricted native-USDC redemption. The backing vault measures both native USDC and USDC.e, so the combined envelope remains 100% without inventing a fixed split.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Polymarket pUSD documentation and the configured onchain backing-vault asset set
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The immediate unwrap route uses Polygon PoS USDC.e and retains bridge custody, smart-contract and pausing risk. Native-USDC versus USDC.e balances vary onchain; no fixed split or independent bridge-solvency assurance is inferred. Sol curation campaign 2026-10-09 (Lane18Ember), observed 2026-10-09T10:30:53Z: the public pUSD description says USDC backing and no fractional reserve, but does not provide a current exhaustive reserve-controller allocation and borrowing-power inventory establishing absence of wrapper-local leverage. The fixed claim does not alone satisfy that whole-allocation proof.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Sol curation pass 2026-10-01 (RuleC26), D09 legal-versus-technical custody review
custodyProfile.uncertainty: The identified backing vault and documented onchain unwrap path provide technical separation of USDC backing. The public pUSD documentation reviewed on 2026-10-01 does not establish enforceable holder-benefit legal segregation or insolvency priority, so legal segregation and bankruptcy remoteness remain unknown under D09. Technical separation does not establish a legal safeguard or a complete assessment of authorities affecting reserve reuse.
